# statusdrift_status_page (Data Source)

Fetches a single status page by ID, name, or slug.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the status page.
- `name` (String) The name of the status page.
- `slug` (String) The URL slug of the status page.

### Read-Only

- `color_theme` (String) Color theme of the status page.
- `custom_domain` (String) Custom domain for the status page.
- `description` (String) The description of the status page.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the status page is enabled.
- `hide_powered_by` (Boolean) Whether to hide the powered-by branding.
- `history_days` (Number) Number of days of history to show.
- `monitor_group_id` (Number) The monitor group ID associated with this status page.
- `monitor_id` (Number) The monitor ID associated with this status page.
- `show_announcements` (Boolean) Whether to show announcements.
- `show_history` (Boolean) Whether to show history.
- `show_incidents` (Boolean) Whether to show incidents.
- `show_overall_status` (Boolean) Whether to show the overall status indicator.
- `show_response_time` (Boolean) Whether to show response time.
- `show_uptime` (Boolean) Whether to show uptime percentage.
- `tag_id` (Number) The tag ID associated with this status page.
- `timezone` (String) Timezone for the status page.
- `type` (String) The type of the status page.
